components.name: Name Band
components.description: Woven navy greeting band with an inset dashed stitch; the greeting line stitches in.
components.html:
Hallo, Lena

Was darf es heute sein?

Sonntag, 11. Oktober
components.css: .ds-band { position: relative; background: #1f2a44; color: #f5f6f8; border-radius: 4px; padding: 18px 22px; text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(31,42,68,0.22); font-family: 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', sans-serif; } .ds-band::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 7px; border: 1.5px dashed rgba(245,246,248,0.5); border-radius: 2px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-band__title { font-size: 30px; line-height: 1.1; margin: 0 0 4px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-band__line { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; opacity: 0.92; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; animation: ds-stitch-in 900ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) 150ms both; } .ds-band__meta { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 13px; opacity: 0.78; } @keyframes ds-stitch-in { from { clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0); } to { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-band__line { animation: none; } }

components.name: Care Label
components.description: The piece's sewn-in label on its detail page: name, category, garment swatches, season symbols. Flat.
components.html:
Lederjacke

Jacke/Mantel

Braun

Herbst
components.css: .ds-care-label { position: relative; padding: 18px 20px 20px; background: #1f2a44; color: #f5f6f8; border-radius: 4px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; font-family: 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', sans-serif; } .ds-care-label::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 7px; border: 1.5px dashed rgba(245,246,248,0.5); border-radius: 2px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-care-label__title { margin: 0; font-size: 26px; line-height: 1.15; font-weight: 500; } .ds-care-label__kind { margin: -6px 0 0; font-size: 15px; opacity: 0.8; } .ds-care-label__line { margin: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 15px; } .ds-swatch { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(245,246,248,0.5); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one thread-red action per screen; disabled turns to chip fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: #b8322a; color: #ffffff; font: 600 17px 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b8322a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #e8ebf1; color: #56617a; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined surface button for non-primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #9aa3b5; background: #ffffff; color: #1f2a44; font: 500 17px 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b8322a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; }

components.name: Confirm Sheet
components.description: Bottom sheet confirming a destructive step: danger-solid confirm, safe cancel focused.
components.html:
Teil löschen?

Das Teil wird auch aus allen Outfits entfernt.
components.css: .ds-sheet { max-width: 720px; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0; padding: 20px 16px; box-shadow: 0 -8px 30px rgba(31,42,68,0.22); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; font-family: 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', sans-serif; color: #1f2a44; animation: ds-sheet-in 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-sheet__title { margin: 0; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-sheet__msg { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; color: #56617a; } .ds-sheet__actions { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn-danger { min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: #8f1d17; color: #ffffff; font: 600 17px 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-text-btn { align-self: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 8px; background: none; border: none; color: #1f2a44; font: 500 17px 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible, .ds-text-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b8322a; outline-offset: 2px; } @keyframes ds-sheet-in { from { transform: translateY(24px); opacity: 0.6; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-sheet { animation: none; } }

components.name: Add Button
components.description: Round thread-red add button in thumb reach.
components.html: <button class="ds-fab" aria-label="Teil hinzufügen"><svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-fab { width: 60px; height: 60px; border: none; border-radius: 50%; background: #b8322a; color: #ffffff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(31,42,68,0.22); cursor: pointer; } .ds-fab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b8322a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Swing Tag
components.description: Kraft tag with notched edge and punched hole; resting, active and with a count badge.
components.css: .ds-tag { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px 0 26px; border: none; border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0; background: #eee2d2; color: #2a2016; font: 500 15px 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; clip-path: polygon(12px 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 12px 100%, 0 50%); transition: background-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-tag::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 11px; top: 50%; width: 7px; height: 7px; margin-top: -3.5px; border-radius: 50%; background: #f5f6f8; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(42,32,22,0.25); } .ds-tag--on { background: #c9a27a; } .ds-tag:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #b8322a; } .ds-tag__count { min-width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 11px; background: #1f2a44; color: #f5f6f8; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Season Row
components.description: Seasons as care-label symbols; filled = chosen, dashed ring = the current season while another is chosen.
components.css: .ds-care-row { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-care { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: none; border: none; padding: 0; min-width: 64px; cursor: pointer; color: #1f2a44; font-family: 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', sans-serif; } .ds-care__mark { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid #1f2a44; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-care--on .ds-care__mark { background: #1f2a44; color: #f5f6f8; } .ds-care--current:not(.ds-care--on) .ds-care__mark { border-style: dashed; border-width: 2px; } .ds-care__label { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #56617a; } .ds-care--on .ds-care__label { color: #1f2a44; font-weight: 600; } .ds-care:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b8322a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Link Rows
components.description: References to other screens as hairline rows with a muted chevron, not tags.
components.css: .ds-rows { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid #d8dce5; font-family: 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', sans-serif; } .ds-row { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 0 2px; background: none; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #d8dce5; color: #1f2a44; font-size: 17px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row__chev { transform: rotate(180deg); color: #56617a; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b8322a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Surface input with strong hairline and thread caret.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', sans-serif; } .ds-field__label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #1f2a44; } .ds-field input { padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #9aa3b5; background: #ffffff; color: #1f2a44; font: inherit; font-size: 17px; caret-color: #b8322a; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #56617a; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b8322a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Text tabs; active label in thread red with a stitched underline.
components.html: SchrankOutfits
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; background: #ffffff; border-top: 1px solid #d8dce5; font-family: 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', sans-serif; } .ds-tab { flex: 1; height: 62px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; color: #56617a; text-decoration: none; } .ds-tab__label { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding-bottom: 2px; border-bottom: 1.5px dashed transparent; } .ds-tab--active { color: #b8322a; } .ds-tab--active .ds-tab__label { border-bottom-color: currentColor; font-weight: 600; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b8322a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Photo Tile and Toast
components.description: Frameless 3:4 photos: selected (ink ring + check) and just saved (kraft ring, settle) with the ink toast.
components.html: Teil gespeichert
components.css: .ds-tile { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; background: #e8ebf1; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tile--selected { outline: 3px solid #1f2a44; outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-tile--new { outline: 3px solid #c9a27a; outline-offset: -3px; animation: ds-tile-new 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } @keyframes ds-tile-new { from { transform: scale(0.94); } to { transform: none; } } .ds-tile__check { position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 6px; width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%; background: #1f2a44; color: #f5f6f8; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b8322a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-toast { margin: 0; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 22px; background: #1f2a44; color: #f5f6f8; font: 500 15px 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(31,42,68,0.22); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-tile--new { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The wardrobe is sewn like the label inside Lena's clothes. A woven navy name band with an inset dashed stitch greets her by name; each piece carries its own sewn-in care label on its detail page; seasons are drawn as care-label symbols in a single 1.5px stroke; filters hang as kraft swing tags with a punched hole; one red thread marks what to do next. Everything else steps back so the clothing photos carry the screen.

The ground is a cool porcelain, never cream, with white surfaces and hairline navy-grey lines. Density is calm and single-column (max 720px), built for one hand at the open wardrobe: 44px minimum targets, primary actions in thumb reach, text tab bar at the bottom. Photos are frameless at 3:4 with only a 4px corner. Type is one family, Jost Variable, self-hosted; hierarchy comes from size and from letterspaced caps labels, not from a second face.

The system refuses the iOS-settings grey grid: no pill chips, no emoji tabs, no grey-filled list rows.
keyCharacteristics: Navy woven fabric with an inset dashed stitch as the only branded surface: the name band on the wardrobe, the care label on an item.
Kraft swing tags (notched left edge, punched hole) for every filter and selectable choice.
Thread red reserved for the one primary action, the active tab, destructive actions, errors and the focus/caret affordance.
One 1.5px round-capped stroke system for all pictograms.
Frameless 3:4 photo tiles; the clothing is the star.
Full light and dark token sets driven by `prefers-color-scheme`; garment swatches are a separate data palette.

rules.name: The One Thread Rule
rules.body: Thread red appears only on the primary action (primary button, add button), the active tab, destructive actions, error messages, and the focus ring/caret. Never on decoration, headings, icons at rest, or a second button on the same screen.

rules.name: The Porcelain Rule
rules.body: The ground is cool porcelain (`ground`), never cream or warm off-white. Warmth enters only through kraft.

rules.name: The Data Palette Rule
rules.body: Garment swatches describe clothing and appear only inside a swatch circle; they never color interface chrome, and no UI token stands in for a garment color.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Jost Variable only, self-hosted; no external font host at runtime and no second display face.

rules.name: The Caps Are Labels Rule
rules.body: Letterspaced caps name a section, a tab or a symbol. They are the heading or the label itself, never a decorative line stacked above another heading.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Every count (section meta, tag badge, action-bar count, backup compare) uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The Four Lifts Rule
rules.body: Only the name band, the add button, the toast and sheets cast shadows. The care label is sewn into the page and stays flat, as do cards, tiles, chips, rows and buttons; inset shadows are used only for focus, the tag hole and swatch rings.

dos: **Do** keep thread red to the primary action, the active tab, destructive actions, errors and the focus ring/caret.
**Do** use the swing-tag silhouette with its punched hole for every filter value and selectable choice.
**Do** use hairline link rows for references to another screen, not tags.
**Do** draw new pictograms on the 24px grid with a 1.5px round-capped stroke.
**Do** keep photos frameless at 3:4 with 4px corners.
**Do** keep every interactive target at 44px or more and put the primary action in thumb reach.
**Do** define every new UI color in both the light and the dark token set; garment swatches stay theme-independent.
**Do** confirm destructive steps in a confirm sheet with a danger-solid button and the safe action focused.
**Do** honor `prefers-reduced-motion` for the stitch-in, the sheet rise and the new-tile settle.
donts: **Don't** use pill-shaped chips or a grey settings-style grid; choices are kraft tags.
**Don't** use emoji or icon fonts for tabs or symbols.
**Don't** use a cream or warm off-white ground; the ground stays cool porcelain.
**Don't** add a second primary (thread-red) button to a screen.
**Don't** load fonts from an external host or add a second typeface.
**Don't** stack a small caps line above a heading as decoration; caps labels are the heading.
**Don't** add shadows beyond the name band, the add button, the toast and sheets.
**Don't** use garment swatch colors for interface chrome.
